description: a deep narrow ravine overgrown with thick moss, an icy stream along its bottom, the huge upturned root plate of a fallen spruce on the slope, loops of black roots hanging from the edge like snares, a pool of thick living darkness with two white eyes at the bottom, centered composition for a round medallion frame, pixel art scene, muted dark palette of moss greens, icy blues and black browns, soft light, no text, no border, no people
